content: {"phoneNote":"The license-plate phone number and zig-zag divider give it character, but the hero is a dim grey photo and „Navodila za pot", "desktopNote":"Hero works well with the car on the lift, but the „Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji", "phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Fill the empty right half of the „Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji\" section on desktop with a map or a photo of the tow truck, and shrink that headline.","Remove the duplicate „Navodila za pot\" links (header, hero, info band on phone) and keep one directions link per screen.","Add a second photo (tow truck or paint shop) in the services or process section so the page is not photo-less after the hero."],"blockers":[]}
